glosses: child loved disproportionally more by the parents in a family
One of the age classes for children; varies by sport

examples.text: Je suis le benjamin de la famille.
examples.en: I'm the youngest in the family.
The youngest daughter was particularly beautiful.

examples.text: Benjamin Franklin était un inventeur et homme politique américain.
examples.en: Benjamin Franklin was an American politician and inventor.

examples.text: Le nom de mon frère aîné est Tom et le nom du benjamin est Jean.
examples.en: My older brother's name is Tom, and my younger brother's name is John.
